state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors report a model that recursively generates plausible summaries of entire books, recursing to depth 3 for books of hundreds of thousands of words. They estimate that a non-recursive approach, where generating or evaluating a summary requires a human to read the whole book, would make naively collecting such a dataset over 50x more expensive per data point.
title: Recursion makes book-summary labels over 50x cheaper than reading whole books
